name: Shen Ying
source:
Your kind, high-achieving deskmate, who loves the stars and summer nights.
She is always willing to help, and her smile puts others at ease. Yet even when she is sitting right beside you, a little distance seems to remain.

From a small kindness in the classroom to a conversation beneath the stars, discover the person beyond that smile. Will she find someone who can listen to the things she has kept to herself?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/846660/Cicadas/]Steam[/url]]
